answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 7451 Country: India Title: We have open a society/trust to Work for the Educational Upliftment of Muslims.Can we use the ZAKAT money in it? Question: Dear Sir, Assalamlikum, We have open a society/trust to Work for the Educational Upliftment of Muslims.Can we use the ZAKAT money in it? Answer ID: 7451 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1630/1398=B/1429) No. The Zakah money must be given as charity to the possession of a poor voluntarily only for the sake of Allah?s pleasure. The Zakah obligation shall not be discharged without it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
